title: He crossed the bridge over the stream of the Tolka and turned his eyes coldly for an instant towards the faded blue shrine of the Blessed Virgin
html_source: The fact that Stephan looks at the statue “coldly” suggests that religion is becoming less of an important part of Stephan and that the Virgin Mary’s impression on him is dwindling. This is also a foreshadowing of him changing his direction in life.

anchor.text: He crossed the bridge over the stream of the Tolka and turned his eyes coldly for an instant towards the faded blue shrine of the Blessed Virgin
